title: Yellowed Bitter Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring tender lamb, bitter flavors, and crunchy lettuce, perfect for a midnight craving. This recipe is onion and garlic free, making it suitable for those with sensitivities.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, ensuring the grates are clean and brushed with oil to prevent sticking.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, pomegranate molasses, sumac, salt, and black pepper to create the marinade.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat, then cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece to promote even cooking.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the mantecare emulsification by whisking together tahini and a squeeze of lemon juice in a small bowl until smooth.
Once the lamb is done, let it rest for a few minutes before serving, then brush the mantecare emulsification over the top of each kebab.
Serve the lamb kebabs on a bed of chopped lettuce, garnished with a sprinkle of sumac and a side of pita bread if desired.
